# Citation Audit — Canon Mirrorless System

Independent source-verification audit (no research-conversation context).
Audited 2026-06-02 against in-session source content. **84 citations.
Verdict: 0 INACCURATE, 0 NOT FOUND, 0 fabrications.**

## Method and access reality

A high share of authoritative domains (Canon spec pages, B&H, Amateur
Photographer, The Digital Picture, Canon Rumors, Manfrotto) anti-bot-blocked
direct fetching. Citations were graded as:
- **VERIFIED** — checked against directly-fetched page content.
- **INACCESSIBLE — CONSISTENT** — page blocked/snippet-only; in-text claim
  matches the disclosed citations.md entry and (for body weights / third-party
  status) the WebSearch-confirmed facts.

**Post-audit source upgrade (manual page capture + spec-sheet PDFs):** the
operator supplied saved official pages, and the coordinator then fetched Canon's
official spec-sheet PDFs (the Canon download CDN and eos-magazine.com mirror are
not bot-blocked; the PDFs were read via the PDF Read tool). Results:

- **[1] EOS R50 → VERIFIED** — Canon USA shop page embedded its spec table:
  375 g with card+battery, 328 g body-only.
- **[2] EOS R8 → VERIFIED** — official spec PDF: 461 g / 414 g, full-frame,
  battery grip not supported, no IBIS.
- **[4] EOS R7 → VERIFIED** — official spec PDF: 530 g body / 612 g CIPA,
  8-stop sensor-shift IS, 32.5 MP, water/dust resistant.
- **[5] EOS R10 → VERIFIED** — official spec PDF: 382 g body / 429 g CIPA,
  no in-body IS, 24.2 MP.
- **[6] EOS R100 → VERIFIED** — official spec PDF: 356 g CIPA, Sensor Shift-IS
  No, 24.1 MP.
- **[3] EOS R6 Mark II** — spec PDF resolves/downloads; not full-read, figure
  (680 g / 598 g, 8-stop IBIS) remains DPReview-corroborated.
- **[81] Manfrotto Befree** — B&H page text confirms the 494 ball head and
  17.6 lb (8 kg) max load; remains snippet-sourced for weight (JS SPA).

Every directly-read spec PDF matched the deliverable's figures exactly — zero
corrections required.
